caption: The drawing depicts a single dark brown metal teapot centrally placed against an off-white or cream-colored background. The teapot has a rounded body with a slightly flattened top, and features a short, stout spout projecting to the left. It also has a matching lid with a small knob handle on top and a large, rounded, upright handle attached to both sides of the top of the body. The teapot sits on three small feet. The surface of the teapot shows subtle variations in color, highlighting its metallic texture with darker and lighter brown areas, as well as visible seams and marks suggestive of wear or repairs. There is a faint text below the teapot that reads “Willem Frank.” There are no other objects or additional details in the composition.
title: Tea Kettle
